recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, two-tone graphic composition featuring a cutout black-and-white photograph of a country singer against a solid, saturated red background, framed by a thick red border. The layout is dominated by bold, stacked typography in yellow and white, utilizing a mix of heavy blocky sans-serifs and casual scripts.
coreVisualRelationships: The singer's white cowboy hat acts as a visual halo against the red field.
The diagonal line of the guitar neck leads the eye toward the primary title text.
Yellow text blocks create a secondary focal point against the primary red background.
The thick outer border contains the internal composition, creating a 'window' effect.
coreInvariants: Solid, flat red background with a slightly darker inner frame.
Primary color palette of Red, Yellow, and White.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The singer is positioned in the lower-left quadrant, scaled to occupy approximately 40% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, yellow blocky name at the top of the frame serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down reading order, moving from the large yellow header to the central photo, then right to the script title, and finally to the bottom-right credits.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant red negative space surrounding the central figure and between text blocks to maintain legibility.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red and yellow create a vibrant, energetic feel typical of mid-century commercial art.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, condensed sans-serif and casual brush script
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses thick, uniform strokes with tight kerning.
Script text features a slight right-leaning slant and rounded terminals.
Secondary information uses thin, wide-tracked sans-serifs.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'W' in the main header has a distinct geometric, symmetrical construction.
The script 'Y' has a long, sweeping tail.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold geometric sans-serif paired with a fluid, informal script for dynamic contrast.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule lines for metadata separation

preserve: Condensed heavy sans-serif for the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, blocky feel of the main header.
Captures the mid-century casual script aesthetic of the title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid saturated red background with a slightly darker red 10% border. In the lower-left, place a high-contrast black-and-white cutout of a man in a cowboy hat playing an acoustic guitar, styled like a 1960s halftone print.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main name in a heavy yellow condensed sans-serif at the top. Add the title in a yellow casual script on the right side. Add secondary credits in white clean sans-serif at the top and bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is the red background vibrant and flat?
Is the photo strictly monochrome with high contrast?
Are the yellow and white text elements clearly legible against the red?
Does the layout feel bottom-heavy and balanced?

mustAchieve: Clean cutout edges on the subject

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is overlapping the singer's face.
Check that the yellow is a warm, golden hue, not neon.
Verify the border is perfectly symmetrical.
Confirm the photo looks like a physical cutout rather than a blended layer.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid Red Field + High-Contrast BW Cutout + Heavy Yellow Condensed Sans + Casual Yellow Script = Mid-Century Americana Cover Style
